gather_sharded_state_dict: gather a sharded state dict across all ranks into a single replicated state dict using process group
offload_state_dict_to_cpu: offload all tensors in a distributed state dict to CPU memory across ranks
all_gather_sharded_tensor: all gather a ShardedTensor across the process group and return a fully replicated tensor
iterate_state_dict_with_transforms: iterate a nested state dict applying custom functions to ShardedTensor and DTensor values
gather_state_dict_for_specific_ranks: gather a distributed state dict so only specified ranks receive the full state dict while others get empty
